description: root CLAUDE.md is present and budgeted (< 150 lines)
command: [ -f CLAUDE.md ] && [ "$(wc -l < CLAUDE.md)" -lt 150 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md scopes Python rules (pytest + the /healthz-not-/health trap)
command: [ -f app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -q 'pytest' app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md && grep -q '/healthz' app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail
[ -f app/inventory-api/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -q 'go test' app/inventory-api/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail
[ -f infra/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -Eq 'terraform (apply|destroy)' infra/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail
[ -f platform/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -Eqi 'delet(e|ing) (a |the )?namespace' platform/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: contracts/evidence-packet.yaml defines provenance fields (source, collected_at, trust)
command: [ -f contracts/evidence-packet.yaml ] && grep -q 'source:' contracts/evidence-packet.yaml && grep -q 'collected_at:' contracts/evidence-packet.yaml && grep -q 'trust:' contracts/evidence-packet.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR CHECKPOINT: agentops/checkpoint-m3.md exists — the investigation's load-bearing facts were written to disk before the window could compact them into a summary

YOUR CHECKPOINT: it records the exact COMMAND that produced the readiness claim and a UTC timestamp — a checkpoint that keeps the conclusion and loses the command is the summary you were trying to avoid
command: F=agentops/checkpoint-m3.md; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; grep -qiE 'curl|/readyz' "$F" && grep -qE '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T' "$F" && echo pass || echo fail

description: YOUR CONTRACT: contracts/evidence-packet.yaml carries a worked example, not just field names — a schema nobody has instantiated is a schema nobody has tested
command: F=contracts/evidence-packet.yaml; [ -f "$F" ] || { echo fail; exit 0; }; grep -qE '^example:' "$F" && echo pass || echo fail
